thread:
emma: quick design check: updated trace viewer header with compact permalink + visible copy affordance. also experimenting with a lightweight export flow (kebab -> Export) instead of a top-level button. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/trace-header-compact.png
rafael: 👍 cleaner. my main worry is discoverability for Export. if its tucked away people might not realize HAR/JSON options exist. maybe show a subtle badge on the kebab when export types > 1?
priya: agree on discoverability but we should avoid clutter. alternative: surface "Export" in the overflow with a small arrow hint (Export ▸) so people know there are sub-options. that keeps primary actions compact while being discoverable.
ben: implementation note: export triggers a server job for long traces. we should indicate that in the UI: "Preparing export..." spinner + toast when ready. avoid freezing the UI.
priya: accessibility: kebab menu must be fully keyboard operable. aria-haspopup + aria-expanded, and focus should move into the first menu item when opened. also menu items should be buttons or anchors, not divs.
a11y-bot: Reminder: ensure menu supports ArrowDown/ArrowUp navigation and Escape to close. also include role="menu" and role="menuitem" semantics.
emma: microcopy changes: change "Share" to "Copy trace permalink" and tooltip to include expiration info if applicable. change "Export" menu label to "Export trace (JSON / HAR / CSV)" for clarity.
rafael: feedback on correlation id: truncate to `req_9f2...1c` but show full id in an accessible tooltip on focus. make the copy affordance a small inline button with aria-label="Copy correlation ID".
priya: prefer using a native <button> for the ID copy with aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip. add an offscreen live region (sr-only) for "Copied correlation ID" announcements. do NOT place aria-live on the button itself.
ben: small UX polish: after copy show ephemeral inline text "Copied" for 1.8s and then fade out. keep that decoupled from SR announcements.
emma: responsiveness: on narrow screens show only icon buttons; the kebab becomes a bottom sheet with the same menu items. ensure export options are visible in the sheet.
rafael: also add a tiny help text under the header: "Tip: press C when focused to copy the permalink" — but only show when keyboard shortcut is enabled in settings.
priya: keyboard shortcut idea: `c` to copy permalink when focus is inside trace viewer. ensure conflict avoidance with other shortcuts and provide a settings toggle. update accessibility doc with new shortcut behavior.
a11y-bot: Reminder: validate with VoiceOver + NVDA, and run automated axe checks on the PR.
emma: next steps: i'll update proto with kebab -> nested export items, inline copy button for ID, accessible tooltip for full ID, ephemeral copied UI, and mobile bottom sheet. rafael to review microcopy list, priya to add a11y checklist, ben to prototype the export progress toast. i'll post before EOD for Friday design sync. :sparkles:
